_doc: Bounties posted on bounty boards (BOUNTY-001). Top level: hunt_chance (0..1, chance per exploring day in the bounty's region that the hunted foe's trail turns up; default 0.3), max_active (hunts at once; only 1 is supported, default 1), offers (how many bounties a board lists to one character, default 3). bounties: [{id, enemy (an id in enemies.json), region (an id in regions.json), min_realm / max_realm (optional realm ids; max_realm absent = no cap), min_stage (optional int >= 0, needs min_realm; same meaning as the encounters' min_stage), reward_stones (int > 0, paid on a win), days (int >= 7, how long the hunt stays open once taken), cooldown_days (int >= 0, before the same bounty can be taken again after it is claimed, lapses or is abandoned), text (non-empty, the posting)}]. The active hunt lives in CharacterData.bounty {id, until_day}; cooldowns in CharacterData.bounty_cooldowns.

bounties.text: Qingshi farmers pay 40 stones for the iron-bristled boar that keeps wrecking their fences.
Marsh-edge herb gatherers offer 120 stones for the blood-eyed wolf that has taken three of their own.
The ridge miners' guild posts 400 stones for the head of the black iron bear king that closed their richest vein.
